references.text: Describes how those who despise the righteous surround him and spit on him, which resembles the treatment Jesus received.
The prophecy of God's servant who offers his back to those who strike him and his beard to those who pull it out, and does not hide his face from shame and spitting.
Paul reminds us of Christ's suffering and how he was mocked, including actions such as spitting and beating, as part of his humiliation.
